title: The right way to move cargo across borders
intro: We help customers and businesses move cargo, cars and personal items from Europe to Africa and the Middle East with careful handling, clear communication and a team that treats your cargo like its own.
processIntro: From your first enquiry to onward shipping, one team coordinates every step.

processSteps.title: Tell us about your shipment
processSteps.text: Share what you are moving, where it needs to go and when you need it there.

processSteps.title: Receive your tailored estimate
processSteps.text: We assess the right service and route, then send a clear, no-obligation estimate.

processSteps.title: Prepare for collection
processSteps.text: We guide you on packing, paperwork and the handover details for your cargo.

processSteps.title: We coordinate the journey
processSteps.text: From collection to shipping and destination handover, we keep your shipment moving.

partnersIntro: We coordinate sea freight with established carrier partners across our network.

pathways.title: Air, sea and commercial shipping
pathways.text: Price competitive shipping for time-sensitive cargo, single items or bulky loads, through air and sea.

pathways.title: Vehicle sourcing & shipping
pathways.text: Vehicle purchase assistance, inspection and paperwork support, from searching in Europe to moving it internationally across borders.

pathways.title: Personal goods & storage
pathways.text: Small packages, personal items or a whole move, including storage and warehousing, from Europe to Africa and the Middle East.

air-freight.title: Air freight
air-freight.tagline: Time-critical air freight services from Europe to Africa and beyond – we deliver your cargo safely to its destination with speed, efficiency and care.
air-freight.summary: When every day counts, we coordinate air freight from European airports to destinations across our network — with careful handling and clear communication from take-off to arrival.

sea-freight.title: Sea freight
sea-freight.summary: For heavy, bulky or less time-sensitive cargo, sea freight is the cost-efficient route. We coordinate container and consolidated shipments from European ports to destinations across our network.
features: Cost-efficient for heavy and bulky goods

vehicle-shipping.title: Vehicle sourcing & shipping
vehicle-shipping.tagline: Find it, buy it, ship it.
vehicle-shipping.summary: From finding a vehicle in Europe to international shipping, we coordinate the journey through one team.
features: Vehicle search, purchase and seller coordination
Cars, trucks, buses and special equipment
Container and RoRo options where available

commercial-cargo.title: Commercial cargo
commercial-cargo.summary: Retail, wholesale or industrial — we coordinate recurring and one-off commercial shipments so your goods arrive where your business needs them.

personal-effects.title: Personal effects
personal-effects.summary: Boxes, luggage, household items or a whole move — we help individuals ship personal belongings from Europe with clear guidance at every step.

vehicle-sourcing.title: Vehicle sourcing
vehicle-sourcing.tagline: Find it, buy it, ship it.
vehicle-sourcing.summary: Looking for a vehicle in Europe? We assist with sourcing and purchasing — and connect the process directly to international vehicle shipping.

storage.title: Storage & warehousing
storage.summary: Short or long term, we store your goods safely in Berlin — and connect storage directly to your shipment schedule.
features: Storage for retail and private customers
